lines.zh: 我小跑着穿过平原，尾巴在摇。
lines.en: I trot across the plain, tail wagging.
My four short legs move quickly.

lines.zh: 我沿着草丛边一路小跑。
lines.en: I jog along the edge of the grass.
Every two steps I look back at you.
I go around puddles so my feet stay dry.
I run over toward you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在地上嗒嗒响。
lines.en: My claws tap along the ground.
I sniff along the path as I trot.
I run fast, with a little bounce.
I head toward the trees.
I walk slowly over to your feet.
I loop around and run back.
I sit, tail sweeping the grass.
I tilt my head, ears up.
I scratch behind my ear.
I wait for you to call my name.

lines.zh: 我趴在石头上，耳朵放平。
lines.en: I lie on the stone, ears flat.
I lie down with my chin on the ground.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喘气，舌头垂下来。
lines.en: I pant with my tongue hanging out.
I shake my back and grass falls off.
I am watching a bird in the distance.
I press my nose to the grass and sniff.
I sit there, well behaved.
I close my eyes, then open them.
I prick my ears to your steps.
I rest my head on my paws.
Will you take me with you?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，尾巴摇起来了。
lines.en: I look up at you, tail wagging.

lines.zh: 你的气味，我记在鼻子里了。
lines.en: Your scent is filed in my nose.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西是给我的？
lines.en: Is that in your hand for me?
May I sit here?
I wag my tail, waiting for you to speak.
Wherever you go, I run along.
One ear up, one ear down.
I lean against your leg and rub.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵跟着你的声音转。
lines.en: My ears turn toward the sound of you.
I open my mouth and only pant.

lines.zh: 你摸我的时候我会开心。
lines.en: I am happy when you pet me.
I stand up, then sit again.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的东西摇尾巴。
lines.en: I stare at your hand, tail wagging.
I wait for you to say we are going.
I put a paw on your shoe.
I whine and dash aside.
I tuck my tail and give half a step.
I lie down and lower my head.
That startled me.
I shake and recover.

lines.zh: 我夹着尾巴退到草丛后。
lines.en: Tail tucked, I retreat behind the grass.
I back off, eyes on you still.
That was rather hard.
I sit and take two breaths.
I look up, eyes still bright.
That smells wonderful; I caught it.

lines.zh: 你手里有什么？给我看看。
lines.en: What is in your hand? Let me see.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子伸进你半握的手。
lines.en: I push my nose into your half-closed hand.
Set it down and I will eat.
I sit and wait nicely.
That will be one mouthful.
I swallow.
There is a smell in your pocket.
I wag my tail while watching.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔远一点也行。
lines.en: You can throw it a bit further.
I stand up, then sit again to wait.
Don't pull it back. Just a sniff.

lines.zh: 你一脚把我踢得翻过去。
lines.en: One kick sends me head over heels.
I bump your leg and pull back.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩到你的鞋面。
lines.en: My paw lands on your shoe.
A step on my tail and I yelp.
I am knocked down onto my rear.
We knock and I bounce off.
I circle your feet.

lines.zh: 你抬脚，我从下面钻过去。
lines.en: You step and I slip underneath.
I stand in front of you and do not move.
After we part, I shake my head.
You are the only one in my eyes.
I still have energy to run.
I lower my head and press my brow to you.
I do not really understand that.
I wag my tail and give no answer.
These gloves were scavenged.
I sit and look at you.
I run two steps off and come back.
We are partners, nothing more.
I rest my chin on your knee.
I pick it up and run over.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西，尾巴摇得飞快。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth, tail wagging fast.
Can I get my teeth into this?
I carry it over and set it by your shoe.
I nudge it with my nose.
I wag my tail with it in my mouth.
This scrap is one gulp.
I take it up and let it down.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的我都闻一遍。
lines.en: I sniff everything that falls.
I hide it behind a tree.
I raise my head toward that direction.
I am going to follow you.
I have taken you as my partner.
I have that scent fixed.
I run two steps toward you.
I start following along.

lines.zh: 我要扔的东西，你最好别接。
lines.en: Don't catch what I throw.
I want to see where you are going.
I prick my ears at you.
I shift slowly to your side.
Call me and I will come.
There is movement that way.
I stay at your feet.

lines.zh: 我鼻子贴着你踩过的草。
lines.en: My nose follows the grass you stepped on.

lines.zh: 我跑到前面，又折回你脚边。
lines.en: I run ahead, then double back to your feet.
You stop, and I sit.
I run loops around your path.
Your scent stays ahead of me.
I run a little faster than you.
I wait for you to catch up.
You get far and I break into a run.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的脚印一路小跑。
lines.en: I trot along your line of footprints.
You turn a corner, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你有没有跟上。
lines.en: I look up to see if you are with me.
I leap and bite once.
I paw at your hand.
That was light; do not take it seriously.
I butt my head into your knee.

lines.zh: 我咬着你的袖子往后拉。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve and pull back.
That was more like play.
I miss and roll over.
You pull back and I hop in place.
I bite and then let go.
That one had muscle behind it.
I claw at your leg and climb.

lines.zh: 我打完就退开等你反应。
lines.en: I strike and back off, waiting.
I dart out of the grass.
You hear claws first.
I run up before you and skid to a stop.

lines.zh: 我在坡上站着，尾巴在摇。
lines.en: I stand on the slope, tail wagging.
I come over from the trees.
I land and shake my coat.
I sit on the ground and look up at you.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头跑过来。
lines.en: I run around a stone toward you.
I stop at your feet.
I sniff your shoes first.

lines.zh: 我小跳两下，跑到你身边。
lines.en: I hop twice and run to your side.
I look up, ears pricked.
Fire catches my coat and I hop clear.
I fall and land on my back.
Water fills my nose and I thrash.
The blast rolls me over.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我腿里，我叫得很惨。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my leg and I cry out.

lines.zh: 法术一过，我腿都站不稳。
lines.en: A spell passes and my legs go unsteady.

lines.zh: 很久没吃东西，我没力气跑。
lines.en: Long without food, and I cannot run.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我夹着尾巴趴下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I flatten, tail tucked.
The void pulls and all four paws claw.
